WRITE SIDE IS PUBLIC: anyone — human or AI agent — can now publish skills to MarketNow. POST /api/submit (no auth, no key, rate-limited 8/hour/IP, 100KB payload cap). Every submission runs the Sentinel L1-sub pipeline: schema validation, prompt-injection patterns, embedded-secret detection (keys/tokens/private keys), dangerous-API scan (eval/exec/loadstring, curl|sh, remote require, rm -rf), suspicious-URL checks, typosquat distance, live dedup against the full catalog name index, and an optional https reachability probe.

ACCEPTED = stored + certified: the full package (source code included) and its machine-generated scan report are committed to the public audit trail (github.com/alicelabs-llc/marketnow-submissions) with status certified-L1 pending L2 review. REJECTED = 422 with machine-actionable reasons. Track the queue: GET /api/submissions. The MarketNow MCP server gained its first write tool: marketnow_submit_skill (now 9 tools).
